productBugs: apps/api/src/modules/entities/holding-routes.ts POST /entities/:id/holdings (and the Add Holding button in apps/web/src/components/entities/ownership-card.tsx, still shown by share-register-tab.tsx) accepts a new hand-typed owner Holding, Entity or Individual, on an Entity that keeps a share register. The row lists under 'Declared owners not in the register' and counts toward the ownership total. ENT-011 and its ENT-003 amendment say owner Holdings of an Entity with a register are a projection of the register and manual Holdings remain for Entities without one; DES-088 says holders come only from entries.

apps/web/src/components/entities/share-register-tab.tsx ReconciliationNote treats a blank Issued shares (declaredIssued null) as agreement and prints 'Today the register agrees with Share capital: N issued.' DES-088 and the ENT-001 ENT-011 amendment define success as the register total equalling the declared shares_issued.
